title.narrative: Yangtze River Green Ecological Corridor Comprehensive Agriculture Development Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will strengthen rural livelihoods, especially the rural poor who rely most on natural resources as the basis for their primary source of income, to modernize their agriculture production systems and minimize environmental degradation and nonpoint source (NPS) pollution. The proposed project will be implemented in five provinces and one municipality in the upper and middle reaches of the Yangtze River Basin, notably Yunnan, Sichuan, Guizhou, Chongqing, Hunan, and Hubei. The project area consists of 48 counties, which are characterized by the prevalence of low and medium agriculture productivity; high risk and occurrence of soil erosion; high levels of agriculture NPS pollution; lack of irrigation systems; limited farm access roads; and are in need for modernization and were selected for inclusion in the project based on geographical, financial, environmental and social criteria. The project will have three outputs: (i) Modern farming systems applied; (ii) agriculture nonpoint source pollution reduced; and (iii) institutional capacity and coordination strengthened. These outputs will result in the following outcome: sustainable and modern agriculture production systems established in the participating project provinces. The project will be aligned with the following impact: improved environmental protection, rehabilitation, and management of the Yangtze River.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3740: 100% of contracts awarded and 97% disbursed as of 27 Mar 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: The project became effective on 26 August 2019. Project implementation commenced in all six provinces.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51116/51116-002-apfs-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51116/51116-002-smr-en_6.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The project became effective on 26 August 2019. Activities for procurement is ongoing. As of September 2023, 355 contracts for civil works and goods are awarded under the project, and procurement of more contracts for civil works and goods are in process. Consulting services including 4 individual consultant and 7 firms are recruited.
